content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** Deviation (walk-away risk) — §28.1's Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction sit outside the accepted list and conflict with §28.2.

**Cure:** One surgical replace in §28.1 substituting New York law for the Singapore law-and-forum words, leaving §28.2's exclusive New York County venue (with its temporary injunctive relief carve-out, which already satisfies the second preferred element) and §28.3's escalation untouched.
